_comment: Scoped to ONLY the custom regex manager so Renovate does not overlap Dependabot (which handles gomod in /tools and github-actions). Renovate keeps the curl-pinned tool versions in the devcontainer Containerfile and GitLab CI current, driven by the `# renovate:` annotations next to each pin.

customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in the devcontainer Containerfile and GitLab CI
